title: Lionceaux: Le Ballon qui voyage

notes.bribri: 12, the big brother. Tall and slim, a thin parting on the left, the faded green number 8 with a white collar. He sees everything and talks with his hands.
notes.kaydoudou: 10, the little brother. A small afro, a gap-toothed smile, a yellow T-shirt with a red stripe, a red sock on his right foot and a yellow one on his left.
notes.mami: The grandmother from Bafoussam, a seamstress and president of the njangi. A headscarf and a red and yellow wax-print dress.
notes.fokou: 62, the coach of the Lionceaux de Bonamoussadi. A worn cap, a slight limp, sitting on his yellow jerrycan under the mango tree.
notes.papa: A network engineer, with glasses and a short beard. He does the Milla dance “with style”.
notes.maman: A nurse. Braids in a bun, gold hoop earrings, a teal and yellow wax-print wrap. “No homework, no boots.”
notes.mireille: The Gazelle, 11: nobody in the neighbourhood has ever beaten her in a race.
notes.ousmane: Little Foot, the keeper, from Garoua. He wears a size 32 and hardly says a word.
notes.radio: Prosper, whom everyone calls Radio: he commentates on everything, one hand in front of his mouth like a microphone.
notes.samuel: The striker: he runs like a giraffe and kicks like a mule.
notes.ekotto: She sells beignets under her red parasol: “Free beignets for whoever scores!”
notes.bile: The neighbour whose fence is topped with barbed wire.
notes.bulldozer: Junior Mvondo, captain of the Requins de Bépanda: 12, “but he looks fifteen”.
notes.diego: Diego Ramírez, eleven, his parents from El Salvador. Small and quick, black hair standing up on his head, eyes that move as much as his mouth. The family's official translator.
notes.patterson: The English teacher of the pupils from elsewhere: red glasses on a little chain, a cardigan with pockets full of markers, a voice that takes its time.
notes.hayesMme: The neighbour: an old lady, a sweet potato pie and an enormous laugh.
notes.hayesM: The neighbour: a very tall old man with a snow shovel. He says little.
